--- 168 pullfrog review > ℹ️ No critical issues — one tiny nit inline, plus an informational note on the docs mirror below. **Reviewed changes** - Restored the `if "tooltip" in cmd:` placeholder-span branch at the top of `render_token` (`native/engine/parser.py:131`), byte-identical to the branch shipped in the initial commit and dropped by the `2f52558` refactor — the `--tooltip(\_)--` token in `docs/resources/chart.md:202` now short-circuits before the `_LIVE_REGISTRY` lookup instead of rendering the `Error: Reference Target '\_' not found` box on the served `/docs/resources/chart` page. - Added `tests/test_tooltip_token.py` (53 cases): parametrized unit tests pinning the tooltip → placeholder contract for the escaped `\_`, unescaped `_`, and argumentless forms; a monkeypatched empty-registry proof that the branch short-circuits; an end-to-end render of `docs/resources/chart.md`; and a parametrized `parse_and_render` scan over every `docs/**/*.md` asserting no rendered component contains `Reference Target '...' not found`, closing the CI gap that let this bug ship. - Verified locally: all 53 new tests pass (1.2s), the sibling parser/doc suites pass (122 tests), and ruff check + format are clean on both changed files; the commit-history claims in the test docstring (branch added in `2f0c3f1`, removed in `2f52558`, token added in `a870d64`) all check out against the actual commit diffs. ### ℹ️ The offline docs mirror still renders the tooltip token as an unknown-token marker The fix covers the served-page pipeline, but `scripts/generate_markdown.py` has its own independent token table whose fallback rewrites `--tooltip(\_)--` to ``> Unknown token `tooltip` `` — that marker is live in the shipped mirror at `assets/docs/resources/chart.md:357`. This is pre-existing (the mirror has rendered the token that way since it landed), which is why the no-drift gate stays green, but the two token pipelines now disagree about `tooltip` and nothing guards the mirror side — `tests/test_docs_error.py` only greps for `` Component `x` not found ``, not `Unknown token`. Worth a small follow-up rather than a change here.
Technical details ````markdown # Mirror/generator divergence for the tooltip token ## Affected sites - `scripts/generate_markdown.py:206` — `convert_to_markdown` has no `tooltip` case among `install`/`source`/`usage`/`demo`/`intro`, so the fallback returns `` > Unknown token `tooltip` `` for the token at `docs/resources/chart.md:202`. - `assets/docs/resources/chart.md:357` — the shipped mirror currently carries that marker. ## Required outcome - The mirror either renders the tooltip token intentionally (a placeholder matching the live parser's semantics) or the divergence is explicitly accepted; the `Unknown token` marker should not keep shipping silently. ## Suggested approach (optional) pullfrog[bot] tests/test_tooltip_token.py:null Nit: "missd" → "missed" in this failure message. ```suggestion f"... not found' error box at a token that missed the registry lookup: " ``` detail-app[bot] tests/test_tooltip_token.py:null Addressed in 1cc34cb. pullfrog[bot] tests/test_tooltip_token.py:null Fixed in 1cc34cb — resolving.   ｜ [View work --- 167 entire 1 blocking gate not passing - ❌ **Findings**: failed — Unresolved findings: 1 low severity - ✅ **Up to date**: passed — Up to date [Trail #109 on Entire](https://entire.com/gh/elviskahoro/-/trails/322/changes/native/109) null --- 160 Review new commits on #168 [3cimp] completed success Review new commits on #160 [08vdx] completed success Review #168 [zlb1o] completed success Review #160 [bnr59] completed success

entire trail — Manage trails across repositories and branches
A trail captures project intent across repositories and branches. Manage intent and discussions on the whole trail; use --repo and --branch to select context for checkout, sessions, findings, and approvals.

When to use this:
Trail commands talk to entire.io and read the saved login from the OS
keyring (the Keychain on macOS), so they need network and keyring access.
If you run commands in a sandbox, request unsandboxed execution for
`entire trail` up front. An error saying the Keychain is not accessible or
the network is not allowed means the sandbox blocked it, not that the user
is logged out: ask to re-run it unsandboxed, and do not run `entire login`.

Current repo: gh/elviskahoro/native  (auto-detected from origin; pass --repo only for a DIFFERENT repo)

Flags:
      --project string   Project as gh/<owner> or et/<project>; required for list, otherwise defaults to the repository's namespace
      --repo string      Target repository as forge/owner/repo (e.g. gh/acme/app) or a clone URL; for list, only filters the required --project

Inherited flags:
      --context name   Act as this saved login name for this command only — including the git and agent processes it spawns — instead of the active context (entire auth contexts lists them)

Subcommands: approvals · approve · checkout · comment · create · finding · link · list · merge · resume · show · unlink · update · watch
             read-only: approvals, list, show, watch — others write

# PULLFROG ACTION — DO NOT EDIT EXCEPT WHERE INDICATED
name: Pullfrog
run-name: ${{ inputs.name || github.workflow }}
# Access model: Triggered by repository maintainers only (single-handler control).
# The prompt input is treated as trusted operator input; no external forks or
# untrusted input sources. Workflow-level and job-level permissions are scoped
# narrowly; no additional credential restrictions on inputs are required.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prompt:
        type: string
        description: Agent prompt
      name:
        type: string
        description: Run name

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  pullfrog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Run agent
        uses: pullfrog/pullfrog@ad4283a862b8377cb525a0f5bf30f17c023b18ea # v0.1.98
        with:
          prompt: ${{ inputs.prompt }}
        env:
          # add at least one provider API key
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}

entire trail finding — Manage a trail's agent findings
Manage a trail's agent-native findings.

Running 'entire trail finding' shows the finding dashboard for the current
branch's trail. Pass a project trail number, ID, or <repo>/<number> to inspect another trail.
--repo and --branch select the working context; findings apply only to that
branch, not the whole trail. Use 'entire trail list' to discover trails.

When to use this:
Trail commands talk to entire.io and read the saved login from the OS
keyring (the Keychain on macOS), so they need network and keyring access.
If you run commands in a sandbox, request unsandboxed execution for
`entire trail` up front. An error saying the Keychain is not accessible or
the network is not allowed means the sandbox blocked it, not that the user
is logged out: ask to re-run it unsandboxed, and do not run `entire login`.

Current repo: gh/elviskahoro/native  (auto-detected from origin; pass --repo only for a DIFFERENT repo)

      --branch string       Select a repository branch within the trail
      --cursor string       Continue from the next cursor returned by a previous page
      --freshness string    Filter code-version freshness: current,stale,any (default "current")
      --include-dismissed   Include dismissed findings
      --json                Output as JSON
  -n, --limit int           Maximum number of findings to show (default 100)
      --severity string     Filter by comma-separated severity value(s): high,medium,low
      --status string       Filter by lifecycle status(es): open,resolved,dismissed; use 'any' for all (default "open")

    the multi-line ``TailwindV4Plugin(config=TailwindConfig(...))`` form the
    CLI injects. The CLI's injection always splices its snippet immediately

    their trailing comma) are removed. Each removed match carries its own
    trailing comma, so the resulting list stays syntactically valid without

    pieces: list[str] = [content[: matches[0].start()]]

    for match in matches[:-1]:

I fixed #167 and removed `Entire Gates` as a required check. #160 and #168 have a re-review request waiting on pullfrog's reply.

**#167: fixed**
- Entire's finding was correct. The Tailwind regex in `patch_rxconfig` matched commented-out or string copies of `TailwindV4Plugin`. A commented copy below the live one could delete the live registration.
- The guard that skips injection also counted a commented mention as already registered.
- The fix filters matches inside comment and string tokens, and detects registration through the AST.
- I added two tests, which fail without the fix. All 791 tests pass.
- I pushed it as `f62ab5d` to the PR branch. `Entire Gates` won't be checked on this commit if you're out of credits.

**`Entire Gates` no longer required**
- I removed it from the "main - PRs" ruleset. The required checks are now Trunk Check, Unit tests, Generate & Verify Docs and Social Cards, and `pullfrog-approval`, in both the ruleset and the effective branch rules. I changed nothing else in the ruleset.
- `.trunk/trunk.yaml:343` has a comment saying the ruleset requires `Entire Gates`. It's now stale. I can fix it in #171 if you want.

**#160 and #168: re-review requested, not yet fixed**
- On #160 I asked pullfrog to review the latest commit, which has no verdict yet.
- On #168 I asked pullfrog to re-review the current head. I'm guessing the failing verdict comes from the informational docs-mirror note. If it still fails, the fix is to make `scripts/generate_markdown.py` handle the tooltip token, which would belong in a follow-up.
- Pullfrog takes about 3 minutes per run. Tell me when to check back.

**Still needed**
- #171 has to merge before any PR can enter the queue.
- #167 shows `BLOCKED` until pullfrog reviews the new push.

    """Locate assets/docs/, searching upward from this file if the current
    working directory isn't the repo root (e.g. running pytest from a
    subdirectory, or from an IDE's own cwd).
    """
    candidate = Path.cwd() / "assets" / "docs"
    if candidate.is_dir():

    for parent in Path(__file__).resolve().parents:
        candidate = parent / "assets" / "docs"
        if candidate.is_dir():

def test_markdown_mirror_renders_tooltip_placeholder() -> None:
    """The offline mirror generator must agree with the live parser.

    ``scripts/generate_markdown.py`` has its own token table; without a
    ``tooltip`` case it shipped ``> Unknown token `tooltip` `` in
    ``assets/docs/resources/chart.md``.
    """
    import importlib.util

    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        "generate_markdown",
        ROOT_DIR / "scripts" / "generate_markdown.py",
    )
    assert spec is not None
    assert spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)

    out = module.convert_to_markdown("--tooltip(\\_)--")
    assert "Unknown token" not in out
    assert "Tooltip Trigger Placeholder" in out

    mirror = (ROOT_DIR / "assets" / "docs" / "resources" / "chart.md").read_text(
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert "Unknown token" not in mirror
EOF

Pullfrog already restarted on its own, so I didn't dispatch it by hand. #167 and #160 are green, #168 is waiting on its review, and #171 still can't upload.

| PR | State |
|---|---|
| #167 | All checks green, including `pullfrog-approval`. |
| #160 | All checks green. Pullfrog answered the mention I posted and `pullfrog-approval` now passes. |
| #168 | I pushed the generator fix as `f1e3ac2`. Checks are green except pullfrog, whose review run (`c800t`) is still going. |
| #171 | The upload job still fails. See below. |

**#167 lint miss.** My earlier push (`f62ab5d`) failed `Trunk Check` with ruff `PLR2004`, a magic number in my new test. My local `trunk check` said "No issues" but evidently didn't run ruff on that file. Pullfrog diagnosed it, and another run pushed the same fix as `9e43c71`. I should have caught it.

**#168 fix.** `scripts/generate_markdown.py` now renders the tooltip token as `> 💡 Tooltip Trigger Placeholder`, the same text the live parser uses. I regenerated `assets/docs/resources/chart.md`, which changed one line. I added a regression test, which fails without the fix, and all 836 tests pass.

**#171 fixes.**
- I updated the stale `Entire Gates` comment in `.trunk/trunk.yaml`. It's pushed on top of the pullfrog bot's retry commit.
- The upload job still fails. `trunk auth login --github-actions` returns HTTP 500 on all 3 retries, on two separate runs about an hour apart. A plain GET to `api.trunk.io/v2/` returns 403, so the API is reachable.
- So the retries don't help. I think the cause is on Trunk's side or in how the org is set up, but I can't confirm that from here.

**What you can do about #171.**
- Check that the repo is enabled for Trunk's GitHub Actions login in the Trunk app. I couldn't see those settings.
- Or turn off the "impacted targets" requirement for this queue in the Trunk app. If you do, #171 isn't needed at all.
- Or ask Trunk support about the 500.

Until one of those works, the 14 PRs stay at `trunk-not-ready`.
